title: Senior Year Admissions Timeline
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: An interactive timeline of one senior year in admissions, with a personal track that changes as you choose Regular Decision, Early Action, or Early Decision.

learningObjectives: Students will interpret a senior-year timeline to explain when applications, financial aid forms, decisions, and the May 1 commitment happen, and how applying early shifts the workload.
prerequisites: Chapter 1: The College Landscape and Application Rounds

keyQuestions: Which plan makes October the busiest month, and why?
What does an Early Decision admit give up that an Early Action admit keeps?
Why does May 1 matter in every plan, even the ones that end early?
commonMisconceptions: Applying early always means finishing the whole process early; only an Early Decision admit ends the process in December.
assessmentOpportunities: Students correctly state when Regular Decision results arrive, what happens on May 1, and how an Early Action plan shifts work from January into October.
